Quartersawn white oak, fumed; poplar slats; 2x4 cleats and center rail. The headboard's rails and the foot rail are through-tenoned and pegged; side rails on bed bolts. Joinery: bed-frame-joinery.svg.
Mattress 60" x 80" x 11" on the slats (no box spring); its top 24" from the floor.
